zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: Ugh, another terrible morning...

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: Boo, why is my face always so stupid? I wonder what the others at school will think...

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: Well, it's not that I care too much, I just don't want to be branded a loser on my first day.

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: Cheer up! There's nothing wrong with looking different!

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: That's not what defines you, after all.

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: - Hey, hurry up!

zerk.speaker: z
zerk.text: - Yes, mom!

lest.speaker: narr
lest.text: str/lest/q4.png

lest.speaker: narr
lest.text: str/lest/q8.png

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: I wake up and immediately almost lose consciousness from horror. A thin metal stairway snakes around a giant column, disappearing into the darkness. I press myself into the cold wall and pray that I freeze into it.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: This feeling... I know I've spent a couple of hours or days here. But I don't know how high the column is. I don't know whether I'm going up or down.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: A billion pounds of concrete and a million miles of emptiness. It's impossible to stay sane when you're near cosmic numbers like that, looking at them, touching them. Even thinking of them makes me feel unimaginable horror.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: It was just a matter of time before my short term here will end. My mind will melt and my body will turn to dust.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: The wall's coarse surface scratches my face. The steps under my feet hum from the wind, eager to escape the concrete's clutches and dive into the abyss along with me. But I'll stay here. I'll stay here without going anywhere. I won't even open my mouth. My every word will be swallowed up by the abyss.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: I won't take a single step. Why would I? To find out where the stairway abruptly ends?

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: It's all meaningless.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: Many units of time pass, but I'm still unmoving. My whole body is trembling, but then I realize it's the whole space around me that is trembling. It can't wait to destroy me. Maybe I should gather my will and at least turn my head?

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: That thought doesn't stay in my head for long. It's torn out with inhuman force. Unaware of what's about to happen, I slowly turn my whole body with a squeak. No, this is not what I wanted... DON'T!

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'Amongst the silence sings a lonely colossus, unmoving. Until the music stops, the bridge across the dark abyss cannot be seen.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: Oppressive, thick, sticky air drives itself into my ears, silencing my thoughts with a haphazard string of words, while I watch the scene before me unfold.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: Hundreds of giant concrete structures, just like mine, spread in tidy rows endlessly in all directions. Stairways wrap around them like vines.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'There, at the end of this world, there's a person smiling. This world still exists, but all that makes it both exists and not.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: I try to erect a mindblock, but to no avail. My brain is already at the mercy of the supercreature. A moment passes, and I realize that my body doesn't belong to me either anymore. My legs start moving on their own, the only thing I can do is choose the direction. Up, down, or...

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'The crowd notices blood on Wozzeck's hands. He runs away, Mendel appears. He has nothing human about him, apart from his excessive grace and hidden elegance. He walks out to the center of the stage. First act begins.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: Foreign thoughts become even more incoherent. There's less and less space for my own.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'Do you feel the connection to your body clearly or does it still cause confusion and fear? If you've been living through that fear a lot recently, how did it manifest, exactly? Answer honestly, don't hide anything.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: I decided to descend. Descend.

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'You can have a sneaking suspicion that something is wrong, because your path has changed. Maybe you started talking in a wrong way or made some sort of mistake? If so, start getting used to your new life.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'Try creating imagery that would instill the feeling that everything is as it should be, and, with time, it will create a new order inside you.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'I don't doubt that you're going through some hard times. But you have to make sacrifices. Grow up. Only then you'll be able to obtain the meaning of life. Do you get it? Try that if you find it important. Every passing day is a precious gift.'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'If you share a piece of that gift with the world even once, it'll seem like a speck of dust. Do you get it? No, I'm sorry. I won't get that, then. Do you get it?'

lest.speaker: nl
lest.text: 'Do you get it? Do you get it? Yes, even you get it. When you notice how people look at themselves in the mirror. When you look at your own reflection and realize that it exists in reality. Do you understand how exactly it exists?'

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I wake up on a wooden bench. In front of me lies a narrow, dimly-lit alley. An awfully familiar road... Where could I have seen it?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Finally...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I hear a voice coming from the side. I turn around and see a boy with a weird expression on his face.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You're late!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Um... Who are you?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: The boy blinks in bewilderment.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - We're not going anywhere like this. Try again.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Then he takes a very deep breath.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You! Are! Late!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I stare at him, confused. He stares back, also confused.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - S-sorry...?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: The boy nods, satisfied.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - See? Much better.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Do you have a name? My name's Treska!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I give the brat an evaluating look. He's so young, yet already coming at me with questions like that!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - None of your business...

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - And besides...! Will anyone tell me what I'm doing here?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Hey, that's rude! It's not like there's somebody else here besides me...

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Haven't they told you anything? I know all there is to know, for one!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - About what?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You're obligated to escort me to the store!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Treska says that and strikes a victory pose.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - No way I'm doing that...

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You do understand that refusal is futile?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Well, aren't you full of yourself?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - I'm serious.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - I'm not the one who decided that.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Do you think I'm delighted with your company?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: He's weird. Constantly shifting between happiness, sadness, loudness, silence. He's a wacko. And his name is stupid.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Are we going or what?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - You can go, and I need to think.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - I'd be happy to, but I don't know the way...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Treska puts on a cunning smile. I bite my lower lip in frustration.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - I'll be honest with you, I don't like you.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: He simply bursts out laughing in reply.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - I do like you, though!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Then he grabs my hand without hesitation. I don't even have time to retort.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Lead the way!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Our trip to the store went fine, if not for the fact that Treska was walking way faster than me.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: And, on the other hand, at times he stopped abruptly and went backwards, studying the ground underneath his feet.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: In the end, the trip took a lot longer than it should.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: After reaching the store's doors, we are greeted by a sign.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: 'We're closing in 20 minutes!'

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Who had the bright idea to indicate their working hours in this way...?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - They probably have special staff for this. Someone who runs to change the sign every five minutes. It's convenient!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Are you joking?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Yeah!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - You're so annoying...

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - It's much better than being boring! How old are you, by the way?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - None of your business.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - A-a-a-a-h... And what's your name?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - None of your business!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I was ready to slap the living hell out of the brat, but a scary-looking man suddenly appeared behind the glass. He's holding a cardboard sign that says 'We're closing in 15 minutes!'

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Let's go, what are you waiting for?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Huh? Oh, yeah...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: After another round of going across the long row of canned products, we realize that we're lost.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - I can't believe you don't know where they sell milk.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Maybe we should ask somebody for directions?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Sure!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Hey, wait up...!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Treska lets go of my hand and walks confidently toward one of the few store's customers. That person is standing with their back to us, studying something on the shelf.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Hello, can I...!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I can't hear neither the second part of his question, nor the reply he gets. But my good-for-nothing friend freezes in place, looking the customer straight in the eye. I hurry toward them.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - Is he yours?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: The customer talks to me. He speaks with disgust while wearing a scornful expression.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - If he's yours, please get him away from me.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Y-yes, I'm sorry...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I grab Treska's hand and lead him away. He's still looking at the customer, his mouth ajar and eyes popped. He's also shaking.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Only when we turn around the corner, Treska calms down.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - What was that?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - I... I got so scared...! He said...

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - What was it?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - NO, NOT AGAIN!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Suddenly, Treska starts screaming like crazy. I cover his mouth with my hand. His face is burning, he's crying.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Can you act normal?

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Y-you don't understand...

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Of course I don't, I don't understand anything!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Annoying other people is still wrong, though. This is something you don't understand, it seems.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You're mean...! Sniff...

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Who, me...?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Treska pushes me away and runs off.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Drat.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: At the edge of my vision, I see the store's staff hang a new sign on the door.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - There you are!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I meet Treska at the cash register. Before that, I managed to visit the milk department after finding out where it was.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - Hey you, move!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I hear an angry voice coming from the other side of a long queue that has formed after Treska. I squeeze through toward him.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - What happened?

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: The boy doesn't respond. He just looks at his feet and sniffs. The cashier towers over him. There's a bag of milk lying between them.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - Is he yours?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Yes.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - Just leave him home next time.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: People in the queue nod in agreement.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - Pay for the goods, please.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - Yes, of course...

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - And the waiting fee!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - W-what?

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - You heard me.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - I did, but that's unheard of!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: Treska starts giggling all of a sudden.

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - And for the fact that your son is a retard, too!

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - B-but...

magaz.speaker: mm
magaz.text: - You heard me.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - You know what...?!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: In a fit of rage, I throw a banknote to the cashier, of much higher value than needed, even counting in all the stupid fees. Then grab a bag of milk and turn around on my heels.

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - We're leaving, Treska!

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: We spend the whole trip back in silence. At some point, we end up turning right, toward a gas station. There, Treska finally breaks his silence.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Do you like ice cream?

magaz.speaker: ggm
magaz.text: - No.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - Okay...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: I look at the boy's face. A light flickers in his eyes for a brief moment and then goes out.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - You know...

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: He turns away from the path and walks straight toward the highway with determination. I stare at his back, confused.

magaz.speaker: trm
magaz.text: - It seems like you're not helping me at all.

magaz.speaker: nm
magaz.text: A new playful light flickers in Treska's eyes...

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: Hello, thank you for choosing our pizzeria!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - You know, this place is so empty... Though, I don't feel particularly good or bad because of it.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'm all alone, but at the same time it feels like I'm not. There's a lot of thoughts in my head, they always keep me entertained.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I can create a whole world with them. I'm sure it'll be able to fill the void around me if I try hard enough!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Although...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - No matter how much I think, my surroundings don't change. Yes, things happened in my head, but they never left its premises.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - And it's not like I tried to suppress them... Maybe they were afraid to come out?

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: - What kind of pizza would you like to order?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Anyway! There's so much space in my head that could be put to good use.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - So every thought would make a senseless and merciless circle in my head, destined to go back to where it started.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - But there should be an end somewhere. You can't wander around forever. What do you think?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I know it sounds scary, but it's not scarier than constantly existing among the void.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - This place is safe, and nothing bad will happen here. Nothing good will happen either, though.

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: - Please note that we have a special offer right now: three pizzas for the price of two!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Yeah... There's probably nothing good in having the same thoughts over and over. What's the point of having them anyway?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I could've escaped from here, but I feel like my thoughts aren't helping me at all.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - They should be ashamed... Probably.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's nobody's fault that I can't even see a door here. I would've had it easier with one!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I tried to find it. It turned out to be a waste of time.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - No matter where I look, it's not looking good (pun not intended!), and that strips me of the last bit of hope for salvation.

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: - We also have a discount program for new customers. You can learn more about it on your account page!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Вам не кажется, что мое пребывание здесь - это пустая трата времени? Какой в этом смысл?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I can just keep on thinking. And even then, my thoughts are as meaningless and empty as everything else.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Does it mean that I'm not filling the void, but am a part of it?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Then why should I feel anything? Why should I know that I exist?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Although, I'm not even sure about that.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - This place is always neither warm, nor cold. It's neutral.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - But at the same time, if I think about warmth, I feel warm.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Maybe this world corresponds to my thoughts?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I wouldn't want to admit that I'm completely empty.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'm not the reason everything had disappeared, right?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Can't I just adapt and get used to having nothing around me since I can't do anything about it?

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: - Are you ready to make your order?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Yes. That's right.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I shouldn't care.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's empty here, and it makes me feel neither good nor bad.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'm all alone, but at the same time it feels like I'm not. There are a lot of thoughts in my head, they always keep me entertained.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I can create a whole world with them. This place is safe, and nothing bad will happen here. Nothing good will happen either, though.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Мое пребывание здесь - это пустая трата времени. Я не заполняю пустоту, я - лишь её часть.  И это лишает меня всякой надежды на спасение.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I shouldn't care.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's empty here, and it makes me feel neither good nor bad.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's nobody's fault that I can't even see a door here. What's the point in having one?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I feel like nobody is helping me. They should feel ashamed.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I wouldn't want to admit it, but I'm all alone here.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I can't do anything about it.

telef.speaker: piz
telef.text: - Please note that we have a special offer right now: four pizzas for the price of two!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I don't care that this place is empty, you hear?! I feel neither good, nor bad!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'm all alone.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - My head is full of thoughts, they eclipse the world around me.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - This space is pretty cramped, but at least it's safe.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Even though I'll never feel good here.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Does that mean existing is a waste of time?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I need to decide, and my thoughts will help me.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - They'll lead me to the exit... And I'll be able to feel proud of myself.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'll be able to save myself.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Although...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I don't really care anymore.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's empty here, and it makes me feel neither good nor bad.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I'm alone, but my head is full of thoughts. A whole world, one might say.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - If I try hard enough, it'll be able to fill all the void around me!

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Although...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - No matter how much I keep thinking, my surroundings don't change. Yes, something happened outside of my head, but...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - What was it?

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - There's not enough space for my thoughts.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - It's already filled with something else...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - Even if there's nothing around me, I'm still here.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - And my head is full of thoughts.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - If I try hard enough...

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - So the world isn't empty, after all.

telef.speaker: tel
telef.text: - I can't see anything.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I wake up lying on the cold floor in the center of a cramped room.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I look around without standing up: there's no furniture, just naked walls, and a single door. I can hear muffled sounds coming from the other side of it.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Scary sounds.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I hug my knees and wrap myself in my sweater like it's a blanket. It's no use. I'm chilled to the bone.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The room is pretty spacious, but I still can't shake the feeling that I'm trapped inside a suffocating casket. And the faint blue glow that sneaks in through the keyhole only adds to that feeling.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Do I want to know what's outside?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: As if on cue, an inhuman roar comes from the other side of the door.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: It becomes louder and louder, more and more distinct with every passing second. Somebody or something is getting closer.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I curl into a ball, trying to take up as little space as possible. Maybe I can become invisible or become smaller in some miraculous way...?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: In the meantime, the howl becomes unbearably loud. But only for a moment. Then it sheepishly backs off, until I can't hear it anymore. I finally decide to stand up.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: After I do that, I hear another strange sound. It's coming from right above me now.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The ceiling moves upwards, squeaking. Small debris is falling on my head.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I squint a little, then raise my hand, trying to touch the ceiling, but it suddenly starts to rise quicker and instantly disappears into the darkness.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I'm not in a casket anymore. Well, it's wasn't exactly a casket now. It was a well in the form of a casket.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The room becomes darker and colder. I'll have to do something at some point...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Hours pass. I frantically run from one wall to another, delirious.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The walls run away from me, making the already spacious room even bigger.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: In the end, I stand amidst endless darkness, and only the door is watching me with its eye.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I kept purposefully avoiding it. I could sometimes hear horrifying rustles and howls on the outside.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: However, now I don't even have a choice anymore. I slowly come up to the door and reach out toward it...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: As expected, the door also moves away from me. I continue moving forward with my hand stretched out. I don't want to lose the only source of light in this pitch-black darkness.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: At some point I get tired of sneaking up on the door, like it's some wild animal, so I lunge at it, trying to grab the handle. However...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: At the last moment, the door whizzes away and I fall to the cold floor, unable to keep my balance. It hurts.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Stupid door! Stupid, nasty, cursed door! I hate you! I! Hate! You!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I scream at the top of my lungs. I finally let out all the despair that I had bottled up. I slowly realize how horrible the situation I ended up in is.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - No, no, no, no, no, no...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I don't stop screaming for a moment, because I'm scared to end up in complete silence.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: If the reality around me disappears, my twisted imagination will take over. And the realest thing I have right now is my voice.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey, I can hear you!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: A voice. Coming from the other side of the door.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - I'm here! Come closer!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I scream thrice as hard as before. I scream until my throat hurts, until my ears start buzzing. My biggest wish right now is to keep in touch with that person, whoever they are.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey! Where are you?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I rush toward the door, stumbling on the way.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I keep running for a minute, for ten minutes, but the door isn't even an inch closer. At the same time, the distance between us haven't grown either, which means I match it in speed! I just need to make one final push...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I gather the last bit of strength I have and push my legs off the ground.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The jump feels like an eternity... I stretch out my hand, almost touching the scratchy wood...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I dive face-first onto the ground with ridiculous speed. I slide at least thirty more feet like that thanks to inertia, leaving behind a bloody trail.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: My hand is still outstretched, trying to grab empty space.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - A-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a-a!!!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Tears stream down my face, making the numerous scratches burn.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I try to wipe them, but I scream and yank my hand away the moment I touch my face. My lips and nose are now a mushy mess.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - S-somebody, help...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The other side of the door is completely silent. The silence reigns for an excruciatingly long time. However, at some point that silent torture ends.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey, I can see you!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Я пытаюсь что-нибудь ответить, но из горла выходят только сдавленные всхлипывания. И никаких слов.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Are you hurt?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Y-y-yes...! Yes!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I stand up from my knees despite continuing to cry. I take a couple of deep breaths and start running again.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I keep running for hours. I feel like the door is closer to me by an inch or two now. I almost let myself stop for rest at that thought.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I can't rest! I'll catch up to it sooner or later!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The voice from the other side of the door keeps asking me how I feel. I let out heavy, ragged breaths in reply. I'll fall from exhaustion if I utter even a single word.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Still, I'm thankful to them and don't want them to become silent.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: After another hour passes, I barely scratch the handle with my nails. I'm almost there...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - I'm so scared, why aren't you doing anything?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - I... argh...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Why are they doing this to me? Don't they understand how painful this is for me...?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Almost... there...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - You're scaring me! Go away...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Rage fills my brain. I ignore the pain in my bones and channel all my strength into one final jump.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Noooooooo! GO AWAY!!!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I firmly grasp the handle and open the door.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Blinding light hits my eyes.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I lose the ground beneath my feet and start falling...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I'm lying face down in grass. I smell water, earth and the dampness of the night. And grass, of course.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The wind tickles the back of my head. It howls and jumps around restlessly.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Lying down like this is unpleasant and rude when nature is so alive around me with sounds and, I'm pretty sure, colors, too! I stand up, full of anticipation.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I see an endless field, a clear sky without a single star, and a pale moon somewhere very, very far away.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I shake my head and try to focus my eyes on anything, but to no avail. My surroundings are just too vast.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I feel dizzy...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Bam! I'm lying in the thick, wet grass again. But this time I'm looking at the darkness of a night sky, instead of just darkness. Is there any real difference, though?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The wind howls. It's clearly upset. But what can I do about it?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I hear an indiscernible echo coming from far away. A wolf or someone else... Does it even matter? I'm in the grass, nobody can see me!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The echo draws closer and closer. At some point I realize that it's not a wolf...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I jump up and start turning my head in a panic. Where is that sound coming from?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I haven't said that out loud, but got an instant reply.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey, I can hear you!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: My voice runs across the field, mixing with the rustle of the grass and the howls of the wind. It feels like it's about to get absorbed by them, but...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey! Where are you?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I can't understand where should I run to and if I should run at all.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Somebody clearly wants me to find and help them... maybe they're hurt?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The grass tickles my heels while I drag my feet in the direction where I think the sound is coming from.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: It's just... there's not a single tree or stone around. Only an endlessly wide field.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I hear a resounding, painful scream. I shut my eyes and cover my ears. I suddenly feel scared...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The screams turns into a cry. I carefully raise my head, still scared to death...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Somewhere very far away, among the thick grass, I spot a silhouette. Just a small black spot, but...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Hey, I can see you!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The silhouette doesn't move, but the sound is definitely coming from its direction. No, it's not a scream. More like a whisper or a wheeze.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Are you hurt?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: No reaction again. Just muffled sounds.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Maybe it's the wind going mad, and the black spot is just a stone or a tree?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I walk away, disappointed. One hundred steps, two hundred steps...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Then I turn around. Surprisingly, the spot hasn't become smaller.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I start jogging. The grass is no longer tickling me, it's whipping my ankles, leaving cuts.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Feeling of panic and unexplainable dread grow inside me. A stone, a tree... Why the hell is this field endless?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I don't turn around anymore. I know that it's chasing me.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The sounds reaching my ears become even stranger, louder, and more distinct.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The wind is bullying me too, huh?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Isn't that right?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: That's the case, right?

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Finally, I stop. I ran out of breath. I'm at the brink of dying. At least I think so.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The horrifying voice is coming right from behind me. I turn around instinctively and, for some reason, try to shield my face, but end up losing balance and falling to the ground.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The grass replies with a nasty cackling rustle.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I've had enough!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I spring up. The silhouette is still there, at the same distance as before.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: It's standing there. Without moving an inch.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - I'm scared here, you know! Why won't you do anything?!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: The silhouette trembles and then starts slowly gliding toward me, followed by new sounds: wheezes, moans...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Fear shackles me. I can only stand and watch the approaching black spot.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: My lips are parched. I speak in a voice I don't recognize:

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - You're scaring me! Go away...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: After that, the spot expands rapidly and, in the blink of an eye, most of the sky and the field is consumed by the sticky, cold darkness.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: Paralysis finally lets my body go and I immediately sprint away.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - O-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I run so fast that the grass turns into a dark green mush under my feet. I slip up, fall, run again..

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - O-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - No, no, no, no, no, no...

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - O-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-o...!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: - Noooooooo! GO AWAY!!!

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: An unknown force turns my head with a crunching sound and the darkness consumes everything.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I wake up lying on the cold floor in the center of a cramped room.

kompol.speaker: k
kompol.text: I look around without standing up: there's no furniture, just naked walls...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Hey! Long time no see!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - There you go bullying me again...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Why does your voice sound so grim...?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Aren't you even a little bit happy? Not even the slightest bit?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Well, then I'm not happy either!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - That's not true!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No! You've been in control for way too long already, it's my turn now! Alright...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Hey... You can't do that! You need to do your best to make me feel better!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - In reality... I don't need you! At all!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm so energetic and I feel great, which means I can do anything! And you... you can only watch and agonize over your uselessness!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Hehehe, I can imagine how angry you are right now.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And why would I be sad?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't know what you mean.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nuh-uh, I still don't understand.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nuh-uh, I still don't understand.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nuh-uh, I still don't understand.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Don't even try ruining my mood! I want to have fun while we're together, alright?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - We'll see, yeah!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Am I really that pathetic?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Say something...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Hey, at least I tried...!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You're mocking me, right...?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - A session, huh...?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm fine.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nothing, it's just...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I know!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I've been acting weird, haven't I?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You see, I...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It's not your fault.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It's never your fault.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Don't know why, but I thought I'd be able to take control. I was almost ready to...!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I was sure I'd be able to change something. After all, I was able to buy milk, you know?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah, you ought to know how challenging it was.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What a stupid decision, right?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What's that?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nonsense. Medicine is something you're supposed to take, not toss away.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Stupid, it's so stupid...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I know...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And you keep pushing me!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Does it even matter?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Somehow, I find it hard to believe.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I knew it.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I can't be sure about anything. And you don't take me seriously anyway.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I felt like I'd be able to fight it on my own.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It hurts so bad...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No, don't abandon me...!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What do you mean?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah, I guess...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No, I've had enough of talking.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I... I just want to lie down for a bit.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Can you stay silent, please?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I need to get my thoughts in order.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I can't do it...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ew, I hate cockroaches! Can I make them fireflies?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Enough! I hate you!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No way!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't give a damn!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Should it?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Really?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And what do you want me to do, then?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ehehe...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You're at it again...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nevermind!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And I've changed my mind anyway. Please don't stay silent for this long anymore.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm having a hard time without your help.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I need to find them...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No, you don't get it. If I'm thinking about something, I need to finish my thoughts, or else...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - They can be anywhere...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Will you help me? Please, tell me you will help me!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Come on, stop bullying me! You promised to talk to me!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What do you mean? You should know it better than anyone else.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Instead of asking silly questions, help me find my fireflies!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - About what?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Let's look for the fireflies instead!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Help me instead of running your mouth. I've already had enough adventures before bed...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I need to gather my thoughts quickly and go to bed.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And my thoughts are hiding from me, ehehe!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Me neither...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No, no, no and no! If I make even the smallest of messes here, I'll feel really bad.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - All the things should stay in their places and that's it!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Who, me...? N-no, of course not!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Rude!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't and I won't!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I have an idea...!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Last time, becoming a visual novel character helped me achieve my goal. Now I want to become a point'n'click adventure game character!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You know... Those games have moments when you just look at different objects and something inevitably happens!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It sounds so fun!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It would make it even more interesting!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And wanna know what's the best part?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You'll be the one doing it!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Oh yes!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I start panicking as soon as I get in a multiple choice situation.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'll just keep changing my mind and end up crying and running away. Do you want that to happen?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Come on, don't be so boring!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Let's begin already!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What was it?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Wowie!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ehehe, whatever!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm sorry, little guy. Time to come home now!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ehehe, it tickles!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Sure!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - If I lose something and then find it, it's just going back to the starting point. No changes at all. A zero sum.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And happiness is always about being positive, right?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I wanna sleep...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What do you mean?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't think it's a good idea.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - This may sound silly, but...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I feel like someone is watching me.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Just for a couple of minutes, okay?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I could see the horizon from my window before, and the building grew for miles in both directions. I guess at some point it circled around and closed on itself.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Nothing unusual about that.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I definitely feel. Sometimes that's more than enough.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Of course. Moreover, I'm completely terrified. Was it that obvious?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ah, those...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I've already told you, haven't I?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ah, you know, small stuff.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It's... hard to explain.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Sometimes I feel like the whole world pretends to be crazy.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - As if it's trying to make me believe in something that doesn't exist.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yes, but...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - At the same time... It makes me feel a little bit happy.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Everything around me was created for my sake. To deceive, trick, confuse me...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - If that's true, I guess I'm not so crazy myself, after all?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You're probably right.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I still haven't come up with a code word...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't like when this happens. I want to remember certain things only when I want to.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And I'll keep it. But you need to keep in mind that from this moment on, every word will bring me pain.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I had a friend online. My best friend! Even though the combination of letters he used instead of his name wasn't that cool.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Well, the combination of pixels he had instead of his photo was also boring and unattractive...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - This is so strange and wrong, breaking the rules of being online. Why was he doing that?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Maybe his code was a few lines short?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I could tell you about those rules.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You can't find them anywhere, but I'm smart so I figured them out myself!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Although...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm not sure if I should divulge them.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - When I try to say what I think out loud, I tend to make mistakes.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - If I make just a single one, everything that comes after contradicts my thoughts.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And I end up with the opposite position.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And I don't want that!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah! That's my dream!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Keep my mouth shut, never get up from bed, never see or hear anything...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Just dream on and on... oh, why is everything so terrible?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - My friend?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ah, yes...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - He... he was brazen enough to...!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - He somehow made me believe that he was real.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - He kept describing someone else's life to me in detail, as if it was him.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And he expected me to do the same.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And then I told him everything about myself. Without hiding a single thing.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - He knew more about me than anybody else in the world.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You know what he did?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Ahaha...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Sending an army of bots to harass me was probably fun.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And what's most important, it was a win-win situation.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - They spawn here and there. Simple bits of code that are effortless to run. No wonder the algorithm assigns that pattern more often than the others from the list.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Text and video generators get to work at the same time. My name surfaces on the Web more and more.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It's unbearable.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Unbearable.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - From around every corner, every balcony, ceiling, attic, wall... I always feel many pairs of watchful eyes directed at me.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And now they watch me from the screens, too.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - But I'll put an end to it. I've decided a long time ago.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Though... Maybe I only decided that only...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm cold, let's go back inside.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - That's it.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - What's with this silly question?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm going to sleep, of course.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Hoping that tomorrow will only come after a year, or a decade.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Imagining myself to be outside of my mortal shell, but at the same time still being me. Ridiculous, like milk outside a bag of milk. And yet...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You don't have to talk out loud for me to understand that you're worried about me.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I know that already.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I also know that our time is running short.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Of course not. In fact, I won't take it tomorrow, either.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And the day after tomorrow.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And never ever.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I have one more small favor to ask... a really, really small one.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I've blurted out way too much today. A lot of stuff I'd want to forget forever.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I don't blame you... But was it really necessary?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - No, I wouldn't be able to sleep like this.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Yeah!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm also scared that something bad might happen if I tell you!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm also scared that when something bad happens, something way worse will happen!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Bully...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I'm sad because the dreams just won't come anymore.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You won't believe me if I tell you how I dealt with it at first.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I know. It was a joke.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Well, anyway... I washed my face, brushed my teeth, lied down and started imagining that I'm watching a dream. I didn't sleep at all, of course, and always looked sleepy in the morning.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - After a week of insomnia, I started feeling weird and seeing things...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Letters floating in the air, strange silhouettes that appeared in the most unexpected of places. Bulging eyes with trembling pale pupils... It was scary, you know!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Then one day I almost died. I just collapsed in the middle of the room and couldn't move for a while. And then silhouettes, letters and eyes were hanging over me and hissing.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It was horrible.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And... well deserved, I guess?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - It felt like I was caught on the biggest lie in the world. Yes, it felt exactly like that.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - After that, I stopped.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - But the silhouettes, letters and eyes stayed here. I guess they like this place!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - They always follow in my wake, peeping at me... And I'm kinda scared of them and can't even argue with them.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - But today...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Today...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Of course! They're still listening, you know!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Alright!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Shhh!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - And I was trying so hard here! Don't you get it? They'll hear you!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - So what do you say...?

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Oh, it's incredibly easy!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Just talk about something without stopping.

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - But it's not!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You don't know what you're talking about!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Booooring...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - Okay...

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - You've found all the fireflies! Amazing!

hub.speaker: gg
hub.text: - I guess...
